output.population: 22 Mandarin-speaking participants (mean age = 22.09 years, SD = 2.83; 9 females) with no comprehension of Korean
output.summary: Task-based functional MRI from Mandarin-speaking adults with no Korean comprehension listening to Korean ballads under music-only, music-with-subtitles, and recitation-with-subtitles conditions. BIDS-organized anatomical and functional images with task event files.
